tagline: Community safety, mutual aid, and Know-Your-Rights for Minnesota.
submitNotice: Anonymous. Source URL or partner-hotline token required. We discard precise coordinates after rounding to the 200m grid. We never collect your IP, email, or device ID.
decayNotice: Sightings older than 8 hours are not shown.

tip.heading: Tip
tip.intro: Donations are split: family aid goes to verified bond and mutual-aid funds; operations keeps the servers and moderation running. Full ledger is public.

kyr.heading: Know Your Rights
kyr.intro: If you are stopped by ICE: you have the right to remain silent, the right to refuse to sign anything you don't understand, and the right to speak with a lawyer.
